mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, temperatures are sitting at 36 degrees with clear skies over Fireman's Park and a Waning Crescent moon visible. The overnight low will be 32 degrees, and there is no rain expected overnight.

The City of Verona has announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11, affecting areas like North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review development projects for the Liberty Business Park on December 7.

There is plenty to enjoy in town, starting with live music at Bailey's Run today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a report covering October 18 through October 24, officers responded to a variety of calls, including a traffic stop on October 25 where a driver was arrested for O W I.
Today's featured flavor is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
